research.topic: AI psychologist / AI mental‑health chat: capabilities, limits, and safe use
verified: AI chatbots like Woebot and Wysa provide CBT‑based psycho‑education and skill‑building exercises
RCTs have reported modest reductions in anxiety or depression, though exact effect sizes and usage durations vary.
AI chatbots are available at any time and can be accessed anonymously, which may encourage help‑seeking among young adults.
Bots have built‑in crisis protocols that direct users to suicide‑prevention hotlines but cannot replace emergency services
A brief mental check‑in typically involves mood rating and may include breathing exercises, with referrals provided when high stress is identified.

research.hook: Ever opened a mental‑health app and thought, ‘Can a robot really help my stress in just 5 minutes?’ Let’s find out in under 60 seconds.
research.tip: Do a 5‑minute check‑in: open the app, follow a 30‑second breathing exercise, rate stress/focus/mood, save the summary, and if flagged, schedule a brief video call with a licensed counselor within 48 h.
dropped: They do not assign DSM‑5 diagnoses, only flag red‑flag language and recommend professional help (unsupported)
Culturally adapted versions such as Wysa India improve engagement for Indian students (unsupported)

data.title: 5 Minute Mein AI Therapist Se Stress Ka Solution

scenes.text: AI therapist sirf 5 minute mein kaam karega?
scenes.text_en: Ever wondered if an AI therapist works in just 5 minutes?

scenes.text: Engineering exams ya placement interviews ka stress dimag ko ghooma deta hai.
scenes.text_en: Engineering exams or placement interview stress makes the mind spin.

scenes.text: Woebot aur Wysa jaise bots CBT exercises dete hain, aur ek choti si check‑in se aapke stress level mein surprise reduction ho sakta hai.
scenes.text_en: Bots like Woebot and Wysa provide CBT exercises, and a quick check‑in can surprisingly lower your stress.

scenes.text: Research ke mutabik, RCTs ne anxiety aur depression kam dikhaya.
scenes.text_en: Research shows RCTs reported reduced anxiety and depression.

scenes.text: Ye bots 24/7 anonymous hain, isliye young adults zyada use karte.
scenes.text_en: These bots are 24/7 anonymous, so young adults use them more.

scenes.text: Crisis mode mein bot aapko suicide hotline pe redirect karta.
scenes.text_en: In crisis mode, the bot redirects you to a suicide hotline.

scenes.text: Ab ek 5 minute check‑in kaise karein, suno.
scenes.text_en: Now, listen how to do a 5‑minute check‑in.

scenes.text: Pehle app khol ke 30 second breathing exercise karo.
scenes.text_en: First, open the app and do a 30‑second breathing exercise.

scenes.text: Phir apna mood, stress aur focus rate karo.
scenes.text_en: Then rate your mood, stress, and focus.

scenes.text: Agar stress high ho, 48 ghante mein counselor se baat schedule karo.
scenes.text_en: If stress is high, schedule a call with a counselor within 48 hours.

scenes.text: Abhi app khol ke 5‑minute check‑in karo.
scenes.text_en: Open the app now and do a 5‑minute check‑in.

data.description: A quick guide on how AI mental‑health chatbots can help you manage stress in just five minutes, their limits, and safe usage tips.
